Our machines are engineered with meticulous craftsmanship, ensuring maximum accuracy, stability, and processing efficiency for a wide range of industrial applications.
Commitment to Quality and Performance # All Fortworth boring mills are constructed from premium cast iron, providing a robust foundation for heavy-duty operations. Key design elements include:
Superior Materials: Every horizontal milling machine is built from the highest quality cast iron for exceptional durability. Stable Structure: Box-type columns, beds, and saddles deliver outstanding stability during intensive cutting. All slideways are hardened, precision-ground, and hand-scraped to maintain long-term accuracy. Smooth Table Movement: X and Z axes are equipped with ballscrews to ensure smooth, precise table movement. Machining Accuracy: Hydraulic clampers on the headstock, table, and saddle enhance machining accuracy. Balanced Headstock: The spindle headstock is carefully balanced, with a counterweight system that enables smooth travel and sustained accuracy.
